title: Warm oil foot massage
steps: Warm a spoon of sesame oil between your palms.
Massage each foot slowly for two minutes, soles first.
Put on socks and go to bed without your phone.

title: Lights out by 10:30
steps: Set a 10:00 pm reminder to start winding down.
Dim the lights and keep the room cool.
Be in bed with the lights off by 10:30.

title: A screen-free last hour
steps: Pick a time one hour before you plan to sleep.
Put your phone to charge in another room.
Read, stretch or talk instead until bed.

title: Cool water on face and eyes
steps: Fill your palms with cool (not icy) water.
Splash your face and closed eyes five times.
Pat dry and take three slow breaths before going back.

title: An easy evening walk
steps: Step out after sunset, when the air is cooler.
Walk at an easy pace — no fitness goal, no headphones.
Notice five things you can see on the way back.

title: Morning light walk
steps: Get up within 30 minutes of sunrise.
Walk briskly outside for 15–20 minutes.
Look towards the open sky, not your phone.

title: Five rounds of Surya Namaskar
steps: Stand at the front of a mat, palms together.
Flow through five slow rounds, breathing with each move.
Rest standing for a minute and notice your energy.

title: Brisk dry hand massage
steps: Rub your palms together until warm.
Massage arms and legs briskly, moving towards the heart.
Follow with a warm bath or shower.

title: Warm milk with a pinch of nutmeg
steps: Warm a cup of milk until it just steams.
Stir in a small pinch of nutmeg and a little jaggery.
Sip it slowly, away from screens.

title: Simple moong dal khichdi
steps: Cook rice and split moong dal together with a pinch of turmeric.
Finish with a little ghee — or sesame oil if you're vegan.
Eat it warm, sitting down, without your phone.

title: Sips of warm water through the day
steps: Fill a flask with warm water in the morning.
Take a few sips every hour instead of cold drinks.
Notice how you feel by the evening.

title: Two dates with a little ghee
steps: Take two soft dates and remove the seeds.
Fill each with a few drops of ghee.
Eat them slowly as an afternoon snack.

title: Fresh coconut water
steps: Have a glass of fresh coconut water around midday.
Drink it slowly in the shade, not on the go.
Skip spicy and fried snacks for the rest of the afternoon.

title: Coriander-seed cooling water
steps: Soak a teaspoon of coriander seeds in a glass of water overnight.
Strain it in the morning.
Sip it at room temperature.

title: Fresh ginger tea
steps: Boil a few thin slices of fresh ginger in a cup of water for five minutes.
Add a squeeze of lemon and a little honey or jaggery once it cools slightly.
Drink it warm, before breakfast.

title: An early, light dinner
steps: Plan a light dinner — soup, dal or steamed vegetables.
Finish eating by 7:30 pm.
Take a short walk after the meal.

title: Warm lemon water with black pepper
steps: Warm a glass of water until it's pleasantly hot.
Squeeze in half a lemon and add a small pinch of black pepper.
Sip it slowly before breakfast.

title: Bhramari — 6 rounds of humming
steps: Sit tall, close your eyes and relax your jaw.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Hum softly like a bee as you breathe out. Prana will listen and guide you.

title: Bhramari — 9 longer rounds
steps: Sit comfortably in a quiet room.
Gently close your ears with your thumbs if you like.
Hum low and slow for nine rounds while Prana listens.

title: Soft, low Bhramari
steps: Sit somewhere cool and shaded.
Keep the hum very soft and low — barely louder than a breath.
Let each exhale be longer than the one before.

title: Three-round Bhramari reset
steps: Pause what you're doing and sit up.
Take one slow breath in through your nose.
Hum three gentle rounds with Prana.

title: Om — 6 rounds
steps: Sit tall with your hands resting on your knees.
Breathe in fully through your nose.
Chant a long Om — 'Aaa-ooo-mmm' — as you breathe out.

title: Om — 12 rounds
steps: Sit by a window or in morning light.
Chant twelve rounds of Om at a comfortable volume.
Sit quietly for a minute when you finish.

title: Bright morning Om
steps: Stand or sit up straight right after waking.
Chant Om with a slightly fuller, brighter voice.
Do six rounds, then open a window.

title: Slow evening Om
steps: Sit somewhere quiet with the lights low.
Chant Om slowly, letting the 'mmm' last longest.
Six rounds, then rest in the silence.
